body.summary: basePlan takes a CommandProfile and returns the commands plus resultFormat and commandsSource; ValidationCheckPlan gains both fields and allows empty commands. runValidationChecks makes no process call for commandsSource 'none' and returns typecheck and tests results that are ok false with a note saying nothing ran. The four route builders keep spreading basePlan.
